title: Relative differentials of a locally finitely presented space morphism have finite presentation
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], locally of finite presentation on compatible etale scheme charts [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. On the small etale ringed sites write $\Omega_{X/Y}$ for the module representing derivations of $\mathcal O_X$ vanishing on $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$. On compatible etale scheme charts $U\to X$, $V\to Y$, with a morphism $U\to V$ over $f$, its restriction to $U_{\mathrm{et}}$ is the associated etale module of the usual relative differential sheaf $\Omega_{U/V}$ [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Then $\Omega_{X/Y}$ is quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and of finite presentation: locally on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ there is an exact sequence $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}\to\Omega_{X/Y}\to0$ with $m,n$ finite. Modules and exact sequences are in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. No Noetherian, separation, or quasi-compactness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: For the scheme-source charts $a,b$, [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence] identifies representable etaleness with chartwise etaleness. Use [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model] to present the canonical small etale ringed topoi on the enlarged etale sites: their structure rings restrict to the given structure rings, composition agrees, and an etale map is ringed localization. The representing module in the statement can be computed as the sheafification of sectionwise differentials by [lem-trf-sheafified-module-differentials-cokernel]. For any compatible square $U\xrightarrow{g}V$, $a:U\to X$, $b:V\to Y$ with $a,b$ etale, apply [lem-trf-topos-inverse-image-differentials] to restriction along $a$. It identifies the restricted module with $\Omega_{\mathcal O_U/a^{-1}f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}$. The equality $fa=bg$ and the composition comparisons give $a^{-1}f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\cong g^{-1}b^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$. Since $b$ is etale, its structural ring map identifies $b^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$ with $\mathcal O_V$. Thus the restricted module is $\Omega_{\mathcal O_U/g^{-1}\mathcal O_V}=\Omega^{\mathrm{et}}_{U/V}$, compatibly with universal derivations. Transport through the ringed equivalences returns precisely the restriction on the small scheme sites. The square need not be cartesian.

source.place: Tag 04CU, lemma-localize-differentials; sites-modules.tex Tags 08TP, 08TQ, 04BO; spaces-properties.tex Tags 03G8, 03LP.

proof.text: For schemes $U,V$, apply [lem-sfb-scheme-etale-relative-differentials-comparison] to $g:U\to V$. Combined with Step 1 this gives $\Omega_{X/Y}|_{U_{\mathrm{et}}}\cong(\Omega^1_{U/V})_{\mathrm{et}}$, with the universal derivations identified. This proves the asserted chart description, even without local finite presentation. Now choose compatible scheme-chart covers on which $g$ is locally of finite presentation, as in the hypothesis. It remains to prove finite presentation on each such $U_{\mathrm{et}}$.

Fix such a chart morphism $g:U\to V$. For every $u\in U$, [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] gives affine neighbourhoods $W=\operatorname{Spec}A\subset U$, $T=\operatorname{Spec}R\subset V$, with $g(W)\subset T$ and $A$ finitely presented over $R$. By [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], $F=\Omega^1_{U/V}$ restricts on $W$ to $\widetilde{\Omega_{A/R}}$; these affine descriptions say exactly that $F$ is quasi-coherent in [pqf-def-coherent]. By [lem-sfb-ring-finite-presentation-differentials], $\Omega_{A/R}$ is a finitely presented $A$-module. The canonical affine-section identification in [lem-sc-relative-differentials-affine-sections] identifies this module with $F(W)$. Apply clause (b) of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine] on $W$: $F|_W$ is of finite presentation. Every $u$ has such $W$, so the local definition of finite presentation in the same cited statement proves that $F$ is of finite presentation on $U$.

source.place: Tag 01V3, lemma-finite-presentation-differentials; Tag 01UT, lemma-differentials-affine; algebra.tex Tag 00RY; properties.tex Tag 01PC.

proof.text: Apply the finite-presentation clause of [lem-sfb-scheme-etale-module-exact-finiteness-comparison] to the quasi-coherent $F$ of Step 3. It gives local exact presentations by two finite-rank free structure modules for $F_{\mathrm{et}}$ on $U_{\mathrm{et}}$. By Step 2 these are presentations of $\Omega_{X/Y}|_{U_{\mathrm{et}}}$. The chosen chart covers cover $X_{\mathrm{et}}$; compose their coverings with the local coverings supplying those presentations, using the covering-composition clause of [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence]. On the resulting covering, restriction of the structure sheaf is the chart structure sheaf by Step 1, so the resulting sequences are exactly $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}\to\Omega_{X/Y}\to0$ on the localized sites. This is the stated local finite-presentation condition. These same finite presentations are local presentations with arbitrary small index sets, and therefore also prove quasi-coherence by [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Neither a finite global atlas nor a uniform bound on $m,n$ is used.

lean.statement: theorem spaceRelativeDifferentials_finitePresentation (f : X ⟶ Y) (hfp : MapIsLocallyOfFinitePresentation f) : (∀ (U : X.EtaleSite) (V : Y.EtaleSite) (g : U.obj.left ⟶ V.obj.left), U.obj.hom ≫ f.hom.hom = yoneda.map g ≫ V.obj.hom → ∃ e : (differentialChartInclusion U).op ⋙ (spaceRelativeDifferentials f).val.presheaf ≅ (Scheme.Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf g.left.relativeDifferentials).obj, ∀ (W : (X.etaleForget.obj U).Etale) (r : Γ(W.left, ⊤)) (m : (spaceRelativeDifferentials f).val.obj (op ((differentialChartInclusion U).obj W))), e.hom.app (op W) (r • m) = (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback W.hom).obj g.left.relativeDifferentials).smul r).hom (e.hom.app (op W) m)) ∧ (spaceRelativeDifferentials f).IsQuasicoherent ∧ (spaceRelativeDifferentials f).IsFinitePresentation
